summary: This study compares two different weight-loss surgeries to see how well they help clear up type 2 diabetes, a condition where the body cannot properly handle sugar. Researchers are looking to see if adding a specific nerve procedure to a standard gastric bypass works better than the bypass alone. The trial plans to enroll 40 participants who are between 18 and 68 years old. NCT07278115 is the identifier for this clinical trial.

facts.sponsor: University Research Institute for the Study of Genetic & Malignant Disorders in Childhood
